{{Quote|Stormtrooper Command governs the military operations of the Stormtrooper Corps.|TX-5532, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''TX-5532''' was a high-ranking [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] within the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Because of his high status, he also authored the Stormtrooper Corps section in the official handbook for the Imperial Military, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''.
